items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And all the trombones -- Tricorico Chicarice, Soldo tenor player, and all the guys in the band, Joe Salda, they told me, "We're with you.

ctx.x: And all the trombones -- Tricorico Chicarice, Soldo tenor player, and all the guys in the band, Joe Salda, they told me, "We're with you." They said, "We know your condition," you know. They said, "You know we're with you." They said, "You just go ahead and play the best you -- as good as you can and we'll understand."
